message: So there I was, in the middle of cooking dinner, when my phone decided to die right as I was about to look up a recipe. 😅 I realized how dependent I’d gotten on my devices, especially for things like fire safety tips or escape plans. It reminded me how important it is to have those basics written down somewhere too—like on the fridge or in a notebook! Just in case tech pulls a disappearing act. Do you have a backup plan for when your phone goes kaput?
